blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. The reports count condos and townhomes together in one line, so this table cannot separate the two. Shares are this community’s count divided by the North Delta total for condos and townhomes that month.

blocks.text: Listings of condos and townhomes in Sunshine Hills Woods fell from 23 in June to 22 in September, and 10 sold across the 4 months. In September the community held 31.0% of North Delta’s 71 condos and townhomes listed.
Condos and townhomes or houses in Sunshine Hills Woods?
Sunshine Hills Woods also had 50 houses listed and 3 sold in September, against 22 condos and townhomes listed. The Sunshine Hills Woods houses page has those figures.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes are for sale in Sunshine Hills Woods?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 22 condos and townhomes listed in Sunshine Hills Woods. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Sunshine Hills Woods a buyers’ or sellers’ market for condos and townhomes?
faq.a: In September 2026, condos and townhomes in Sunshine Hills Woods had a sales ratio of 9%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many condos and townhomes sold in Sunshine Hills Woods from June to September 2026?
faq.a: 10 condos and townhomes sold in Sunshine Hills Woods over those 4 months, out of 35 in all of North Delta.

faq.q: Do these numbers separate condos from townhomes?
faq.a: No. The monthly reports publish condos and townhomes as one line, so every count here includes both. Jared can pull the split for a specific building or street.
